stayTerms.bodyMarkdown:
# Booking terms & cancellation policy

## 1. What a request is

Submitting the booking form sends a request. It is not a confirmed booking until the host approves it in writing by email.

## 2. Approval and payment

When the host approves, the approval email states the final amount and how to pay. Typically a bank transfer confirms the dates and the balance is paid on arrival. No payment is taken on this website.

## 3. Cancellation

Cancel 14 or more days before check-in for a full refund of anything paid. Cancel 7–13 days before for a 50% refund. Inside 7 days, amounts paid are non-refundable. The cleaning fee is always refunded if you cancel before check-in.

## 4. Changes to dates

One free date change is allowed up to 14 days before check-in, subject to availability and any rate difference.

## 5. No-show

If you do not arrive and do not contact the host within 24 hours of the check-in date, the booking is cancelled with no refund.

## 6. Host cancellation

If the host has to cancel, you receive a full refund of everything paid and help finding an alternative. The host's liability is limited to the amount paid.

## 7. House rules

The house rules form part of these terms and are accepted at the same time.

houseRules.bodyMarkdown:
# House rules

## Occupancy

The maximum is 4 guests, matching the number on the booking. Everyone staying overnight must be named.

## Smoking

No smoking or vaping anywhere indoors or in the car. Smoking is allowed on the terrace.

## Parties and events

No parties, events, or commercial photography. Daytime visitors are fine within reason.

## Quiet hours

Quiet hours are 22:00 to 06:00 out of respect for neighbours in the compound.

## Pets

No pets at this time.

## Damage

Tell the host about any breakage. Accidental damage is expected occasionally; the cost of deliberate or negligent damage is charged.

## Check-out

By 11:00 unless a later time is agreed. Start the dishwasher, put rubbish in the outdoor bins, and leave the keys in the lockbox.

privacy.bodyMarkdown:
# Privacy policy

## Who we are

Kigali Keys is the data controller for the information described here. Contact: host@kigalikeys.rw.

## What we collect

When you submit a booking request we collect your name, email, phone number, country of residence, the purpose of your stay, and any message you send. If you add the car, we also collect the primary driver's full name, date of birth, driving licence number, and issuing country. When you accept the agreements we record the version accepted, the date and time, and your IP address and browser user agent as proof of acceptance.

## Why we hold it and the lawful basis

We use booking data to assess and process your request, to contact you about it, and to meet our legal and tax obligations. The lawful basis is performance of a contract (or steps toward one) and our legitimate interest in running the property. Acceptance metadata is kept because the host approves a booking on the basis that you agreed to the terms.

## Driver licence data

Driving licence number and date of birth are collected only when the car is added, are visible only to the host and administrators, are never shown on public pages, and are used only to check driver eligibility and complete the rental agreement.

## Retention

Booking and acceptance records are kept for seven years to meet tax and contractual requirements, then deleted. Contact-form messages are kept for two years.

## Third parties

We use an email delivery provider to send booking and contact emails, and a map and image hosting provider to serve static maps and photos. These providers act on our instructions and do not use your data for their own purposes. We do not sell personal data.

## Your rights

You can ask for a copy of your data, correction of it, deletion where we no longer need it, or restriction of its use. Email host@kigalikeys.rw and we will respond within one month. If you are in the EU or UK you may also complain to your local data protection authority.

## Changes

We version this policy; the effective date is shown above.

cancellationPolicy.bodyMarkdown:
# Cancellation & stay terms

## What a request means

A request holds nothing until the host approves it. Dates are only committed once you receive an approval email.

## How approval works

The host reviews each request, usually within 24–48 hours, and replies by email with either an approval (including the final amount, the address, and check-in details) or a decline with a reason.

## Payment

No payment is taken on this site. The approval email sets out how to pay — usually a transfer to confirm and the balance on arrival. The car is paid on site at collection.

## Cancellation windows and refunds

- 14+ days before check-in: full refund of anything paid.
- 7–13 days before: 50% refund of the accommodation.
- 0–6 days before: no refund of the accommodation.
- The cleaning fee is refunded on any cancellation made before check-in.

## Changes to dates

One free change up to 14 days before check-in, subject to availability and any rate difference. Later changes are treated as a cancellation and a new request.

## No-show

No arrival and no contact within 24 hours of the check-in date cancels the booking with no refund.

## Host cancellation

If the host cancels for any reason, you get a full refund of everything paid and reasonable help finding an alternative. The host's liability is limited to the amount you paid.

## Future paid bookings

When online payment is introduced, a paid-booking refund section will be added here; it will not change the windows above for request bookings.
